Pick each FDIS site visit's stream from the nearest snap and the streams its 1:50k code names

Source: R/fdis_place.R
knw_fdis_place.Rd

scripts/0230 snaps every visit twice with fresh::frs_point_snap(): once to the nearest stream, and once to each stream its FDIS 1:50k watershed code names (the code's 20k blue_line_keys from fwa_streams_20k_50k, passed as a hint, so that snap can land only on that stream). This function makes the pick from the two results, with no database.

Usage

knw_fdis_place(nearest, hinted, limit_near = 200, limit_code = 500)

Arguments

nearest

data.frame, one row per visit to place: site_visit, blue_line_key, downstream_route_measure, linear_feature_id, distance_to_stream, with the four position columns missing where no stream lies within the search.

hinted

data.frame, one row per visit and stream its code names: site_visit, hint_blue_line_key (the stream named) and the four position columns of the hinted snap, missing where that stream is not within the search. A visit with no row here has no code the cross-reference knows. Every site_visit must be in nearest.

limit_near

numeric(1) metres: an unconfirmed pick farther than this is flagged flag_far_snap.

limit_code

numeric(1) metres: a confirmed pick farther than this is flagged flag_far_snap.

Value

A tibble, one row per row of nearest in its order: site_visit, blue_line_key, downstream_route_measure, linear_feature_id, distance_to_stream (the pick's), snap_method (code, nearest, or NA when not placed), snap_confirmed, snap_moved, nearest_distance_m, ws50_checked (the visit has a code the cross-reference knows), flag_not_placed, flag_far_snap and flag_ws50_mismatch. integer64 columns are refused: convert them with as.numeric() first, as 0230 does.

Details

A visit whose code names a stream within the search takes the nearest such stream (snap_method = "code", snap_confirmed = TRUE): the placement is on a stream the code names, which is what 0230's check has always asked. Where that stream is not the nearest one, the visit is moved to it (snap_moved). A visit with no code the cross-reference knows takes the nearest stream (snap_method = "nearest", unconfirmed). A visit whose code names streams none of which lies within the search keeps the nearest placement and is flagged flag_ws50_mismatch: the code contradicts every stream in reach, so there is nothing to move it to.

A confirmed pick and an unconfirmed one are held to different limits, because distance predicts a wrong stream only where nothing names the stream: flag_far_snap marks an unconfirmed pick beyond limit_near and a confirmed one beyond limit_code. Ties in distance go to the lowest linear_feature_id, as in frs_point_snap().

The default limits are the ones 0230 uses, set by data-raw/snap_limit_sensitivity.R (#91): 200 m, the widest distance band whose code-checked disagreement stays under one in three, for an unconfirmed pick, and the 500 m search radius for a confirmed one.

Examples

nearest <- data.frame(
  site_visit = c("a", "b", "c"),
  blue_line_key = c(1, 1, 2), downstream_route_measure = c(10, 50, 5),
  linear_feature_id = c(11, 12, 21), distance_to_stream = c(4, 30, 150)
)
# b's code names stream 3, 60 m away; c's code names stream 2, its nearest
hinted <- data.frame(
  site_visit = c("b", "c"), hint_blue_line_key = c(3, 2),
  blue_line_key = c(3, 2), downstream_route_measure = c(80, 5),
  linear_feature_id = c(31, 21), distance_to_stream = c(60, 150)
)
knw_fdis_place(nearest, hinted, limit_near = 100, limit_code = 500)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 13
#>   site_visit blue_line_key downstream_route_measure linear_feature_id
#>   <chr>              <dbl>                    <dbl>             <dbl>
#> 1 a                      1                       10                11
#> 2 b                      3                       80                31
#> 3 c                      2                        5                21
#> # ℹ 9 more variables: distance_to_stream <dbl>, snap_method <chr>,
#> #   snap_confirmed <lgl>, snap_moved <lgl>, nearest_distance_m <dbl>,
#> #   ws50_checked <lgl>, flag_not_placed <lgl>, flag_far_snap <lgl>,
#> #   flag_ws50_mismatch <lgl>
